1.consolidated_definition: Hormiga cortadora, grande y voraz, de color rojizo, con cabeza lisa y brillante, mandíbulas desarrolladas y tórax bien separado del abdomen. Formicidae Atta insularis Aspp.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Large and voracious red-colored cutting ant with a smooth and shiny head, developed mandibles, and well-separated thorax from abdomen. Formicidae Atta insularis Aspp.
